headline: Asian stock market August 17 – Japan closed mixed, Seoul had a national holiday, oil declines
summary: Asian stock markets started the week mixed, with the Nikkei rising while the Topix showed weakness. South Korea had no trading due to a national holiday, and Australia closed lower.
why: The Nikkei 225 is Japan's benchmark stock index, tracking large Tokyo-listed companies and serving as a gauge of Japanese equity sentiment.
